preconditions.description: There are exactly 5 blimp registration codes.
Each registration code has at most 11 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalnum() or c == '-' for c in code) for code in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each character in a registration code is an uppercase letter, digit, or dash.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'HE GOT AWAY!' or a space-separated list of indices of CIA blimps.

postconditions.expression: cia_indices == [i + 1 for i, code in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()) if 'FBI' in code]
postconditions.description: The list of CIA blimp indices correctly identifies lines containing 'FBI'.
